provenance.wording: Exploratory development results on one partition. The candidates were chosen after seeing 3C.1 results. Any final claim uses the existing reserved-recording protocol (the loco_* and other reserved-test columns in metadata.csv), opened once at the end. All nine fault classes have informed development decisions. Reserved recordings test those decisions; they do not establish performance on entirely new fault families.

criteria_definition: Problem 1: fewer withheld instances passed as known than rule B, with the known-fault false-unknown macro rates on (a) and (b) each at most 2 points above rule B's. Problem 2: fewer withheld instances called healthy than rule B, with the change in normal instances sent to unknown. Pass/fail only; no selection, no ratio or cost conclusion.

threshold_free.wording: an interval excluding zero supports a specific metric difference under this protocol, not an overall winner
